description_en: Provides server-side card and certificate OCR capabilities
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl doc-ocr --merchant-biz-id dso9322000dsjsd22 --merchant-user-id 123456789 --id-ocr-picture-base64 base64 --id-ocr-picture-url https://digital-cardocr-prod8.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/1669520556530-expo/default/face/20221127114236530_w3kx2e6t.jpg --doc-type 00000006 --product-code '产品方案类型ID_OCR_MIN' --ocr T --id-face-quality F --spoof F --id-threshold 0 --card-side OCR_ID_FACE --region cn-hangzhou
name: DocOcr

parameters.help_en: The custom business unique identifier on the merchant side, used for subsequent issue tracking and troubleshooting. The value can be a combination of letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID in the business. Ensure that the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 业务中自定义的用户ID，请保持唯一
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded card or certificate image.

If you use IdOcrPictureBase64 (Base64-encoded photo) to submit the certificate photo, check the photo size and do not submit an excessively large photo
parameters.help_zh:
卡证图片Base64编码。

如果您选择IdOcrPictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入证件照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the front side of the certificate image
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform certificate OCR. Valid values:
T: OCR is required.
F: OCR is not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行证件OCR
T：表示需要证件OCR
F：表示不需要
parameters.name: ocr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform certificate face quality detection. Valid values:
T: Detection is required.
F: Detection is not required. (Default value: F)
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行证脸质量检测
T：表示需要检测
F：表示需要检测（默认F）
parameters.name: id_face_quality

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable anti-spoofing detection. Valid values:
T: Anti-spoofing is enabled.
F: Anti-spoofing is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启防伪检测
T：表示开启防伪
F：表示关闭
parameters.name: spoof

parameters.help_en:
The custom OCR quality detection threshold mode. Valid values:

0: system default
1: strict mode
2: loose mode
3 (default): quality detection disabled
parameters.help_zh:
自定义OCR质量检测阈值模式：

0：系统默认
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the side of the certificate to distinguish between the national emblem side and the portrait side. If this parameter is not specified, the portrait side is used by default. Valid values:

OCR_ID_FACE (default): portrait side

OCR_ID_NATIONAL_EMBLEM: national emblem side
parameters.help_zh:
区分证件国徽面和人像面 ，不传默认人像面 。

OCR_ID_FACE （默认）：人像面

OCR_ID_NATIONAL_EMBLEM ：国徽面
parameters.name: card_side

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The card and certificate recognition result. This parameter is returned only when the API response is successful
ExtIdInfo.description_zh: 卡证识别结果只有当接口响应成功时返回

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the authentication is passed. Valid values:

Y: Passed.
N: Not passed
Passed.description_zh:
认证是否通过。

Y：通过
N：不通过

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the authentication request
